result.summary: The image shows a residential intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. While basic pedestrian infrastructure is present, the lack of signalization and presence of parked cars near the crossing may impact visibility and safety.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the crosswalk on both sides of the street obstruct the sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Along the curbs adjacent to the crosswalks.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions (Bulb-outs)
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten crossing distance and improve pedestrian visibility.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve sightlines.

result.summary: The image shows a residential street intersection with marked zebra crosswalks and sidewalks on both sides. However, there is a lack of visible traffic control devices like stop signs or signals, and parked vehicles near the corners obstruct sightlines between drivers and pedestrians.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked right up to the crosswalk edge block the view of pedestrians for oncoming traffic.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the street near the foreground crosswalk

hazards.name: Lack of Intersection Control
hazards.description: No stop signs or traffic signals are visible to regulate vehicle flow at the intersection.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: The sidewalk on the right side shows significant cracking and uneven surfaces, posing a trip hazard.

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces immediately adjacent to the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Install bulb-outs to shorten the pedestrian crossing distance and physically prevent parking too close to the intersection.

interventions.title: All-Way Stop Control
interventions.description: Install stop signs to regulate traffic and provide clear right-of-way for pedestrians.

result.summary: This is a residential street with row housing and sidewalks on both sides. While a marked zebra crosswalk is present, the environment lacks ADA-compliant curb ramps and daylighting at the crossing point.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Vehicles
hazards.description: Vehicles parked immediately adjacent to the crosswalk block sightlines between pedestrians and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Left and right foreground near the crosswalk markings

hazards.name: Missing Curb Ramps
hazards.description: The sidewalk lacks sloped transitions to the roadway at the marked crosswalk, creating a barrier for people with mobility aids.
hazards.location_in_image: Left foreground where the crosswalk meets the curb

interventions.title: Daylighting
interventions.description: Remove parking spaces within 20 feet of the crosswalk to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: ADA Curb Ramps
interventions.description: Install detectable warning surfaces and sloped ramps at the crossing points.

interventions.title: Curb Extensions
interventions.description: Extend the sidewalk into the parking lane to shorten the crossing distance and physically prevent illegal parking near the crosswalk.

result.summary: The pedestrian environment consists of a residential street with continuous sidewalks and a marked crosswalk at the intersection. Safety is compromised by faded pavement markings, poor sidewalk maintenance with significant cracking and weeds, and parked cars that obstruct visibility at the corner.

hazards.name: Visual Obstruction from Parked Cars
hazards.description: Vehicles parked close to the intersection corner block sightlines between pedestrians waiting to cross and approaching drivers.
hazards.location_in_image: Right side of the roadway along the curb line.

hazards.name: Degraded Sidewalk Surface
hazards.description: Significant cracking and vegetation growth create an uneven walking surface and potential tripping hazards.

hazards.name: Faded Crosswalk Markings
hazards.description: The ladder-style crosswalk markings are significantly worn, reducing their visibility to approaching motorists.

interventions.title: Intersection Daylighting
interventions.description: Restrict parking within 20-30 feet of the intersection to improve visibility for all road users.

interventions.title: High-Visibility Crosswalk Refresh
interventions.description: Repaint the crosswalk with high-visibility thermoplastic markings to improve driver awareness.

interventions.title: Sidewalk Rehabilitation
interventions.description: Repair cracked and uneven sidewalk panels to ensure a smooth, accessible path of travel.
